message.content:
Sure! If you’re on a Windows machine, you can quickly see the current date and time right from the Command Prompt:

```cmd
C:\> echo %date% %time%
```

or, if you prefer separate commands:

```cmd
C:\> date /t   &   time /t
```

Running either of those will print something like:

```
Thu 06/23/2026  10:45:12.34
```

(Your actual output will reflect whatever the system clock shows at the moment you run it.)
